notes.title: FAS: Fight Action Sandbox - Out Now!
notes.content:
FAS has officially launched!
We are very excited to release FAS!
In the meantime, we received feedback from beta testers and proceeded with major updates.
Build your own character, fight AI or duel with friends online! 
Enjoy FAS:)
